name: 18326 · Cresco, PA
findings: ZIP 18326 (Cresco) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (100% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18326 (Cresco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
